metadata.description: A small collection of general-purpose Claude Code skills — career-search clarity, skill authoring, document rendering. No dependency on the author's data or folder layout.

plugins.name: mnookin-two-pager
plugins.description: Build a Never Search Alone (Mnookin) two-pager through a one-question-at-a-time interview, then keep your downstream career docs (shortlist, CV variants, screening questions) in sync with it.

plugins.name: conversation-to-skill
plugins.description: Distill a finished conversation into a reusable Claude Code skill — extract the repeatable workflow, encode the user's corrections as edge cases, write SKILL.md, and test it.

plugins.name: markdown-to-pdf
plugins.description: Render a Markdown file to a styled PDF via pandoc + headless Chrome. Bundled compact and prose stylesheets or bring your own; optional preamble-strip and page-count guard.
